basis: Ichthyosis with defining severe ectropion and eclabium; hearing abnormalities occur in 80-99%. Joint restriction reflects tight skin rather than direct joint or muscle damage.

decisions.gastrointestinal: primary: defining eclabium deforms the lips and oral aperture; the mouth maps to gastrointestinal.
decisions.ocular: primary: severe eyelid ectropion is explicitly part of the disease definition.
decisions.musculoskeletal: none: joint restriction from tight skin does not establish direct skeletal muscle or joint damage.

basis: Neurodevelopmental disease with bile-acid dysregulation; hepatic cholestasis in 4/11 and urinary reflux in 6/8. Ptosis (4/13) omitted at the four-axis cap.

decisions.hepatic: involved: conjugated hyperbilirubinemia in 4/11, elevated aminotransferases in 31-46%, and hepatomegaly in 5/12 support direct hepatic dysfunction.
decisions.metabolic_endocrine: primary: familial hypercholanemia represents the defining inherited disturbance of bile-acid metabolism and transport.

basis: Progressive myopathy with defining eyelid and pharyngeal dysfunction; direct tongue atrophy and weakness occur in 30-79%, supporting gastrointestinal involvement.

decisions.pulmonary: primary: defining pharyngeal muscle dysfunction affects the pharynx, explicitly assigned to pulmonary by the guide.
decisions.gastrointestinal: involved: tongue atrophy and weakness occur in 30-79%; these directly affect oral tissue beyond the defining pharyngeal dysfunction.

basis: Congenital fistula between hepatic arterial and portal venous vessels; both its vascular nature and intrahepatic location define the lesion.

decisions.hepatic: primary: the lesion is explicitly located within the liver; primary location does not require additional evidence of secondary hepatic injury.

basis: Odontogenic origin maps to gastrointestinal; the vast majority of tumors directly occupy and expand jaw bone.

decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: the vast majority are intraosseous, directly occupying jaw bone; tumor occupation qualifies without a separate skeletal diagnosis.

basis: Inherited mucocutaneous candidiasis with oral thrush and dermatitis in 2/2; blepharitis represents direct eyelid inflammation in 1/2, with substantial small-cohort uncertainty.

decisions.ocular: involved: blepharitis is direct eyelid inflammation reported in 1/2 patients (50%); the supplied phenotype evidence supports inclusion despite the small cohort.

basis: Cleft palate and severe congenital heart defects define the syndrome; mandibular hypoplasia occurs in 80-99% and clinodactyly in 30-79%, supporting persistent skeletal involvement.

decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: micrognathia is mandibular hypoplasia in 80-99%, accompanied by clinodactyly in 30-79%; these are persistent skeletal malformations.

basis: Benign vascular endothelial tumor arising in the skin; cutaneous location and blood-vessel origin both define the neoplasm.

decisions.cardiovascular: primary: a hemangioma is a blood-vessel neoplasm; its endothelial vascular origin qualifies independently of secondary cardiovascular dysfunction.

basis: The defining syndrome comprises progressive nephropathy, sensorineural hearing loss and characteristic ocular defects; lenticonus is diagnostic despite infrequent vision loss.

decisions.ocular: primary: characteristic ocular abnormalities are part of the defining syndrome; lenticonus is a major diagnostic feature, rather than merely incidental retinal flecks.
decisions.otologic: primary: sensorineural hearing loss is a defining component of Alport syndrome and is frequent (30-79%) in the supplied annotations.

basis: FASLG-related autoimmune lymphoproliferative syndrome is defined by immune dysregulation, defective lymphocyte apoptosis and abnormal lymphocyte accumulation.

decisions.haematologic: primary: the ALPS synonyms identify a disease of lymphocytes with defining nonmalignant lymphoproliferation; this is intrinsic blood-cell pathology.
